relationships.evidence_quote: These daily NO2G data are found to be more convenient by some users than using the orbital files for producing daily mappings of the data, generating their own L3 products, and evaluating model output using satellite NO2 observations.
relationships.rationale: Decision step 6: both are daily 0.25° mappings of the same L2 product (L3 screened, L2G unscreened, intended for users' own L3); neither is made from the other, and the documents do not say they come from one run.

metadata_findings: The only MetadataAssociation is SCIENCE ASSOCIATED to the record itself (OMI_MINDS_NO2d 1.1): a self-relation, which should be removed or replaced with the lineage below.
The DATA SET LANDING PAGE (https://www.earthdata.nasa.gov/data/catalog/ges-disc-haqes-na-pm25-oc-county-1) is the landing page of an unrelated dataset.
No ATBD in RelatedUrls; the only document is the shared MEaSUREs README.
The Abstract is the MINDS project description in the future tense ("will develop ..."); it does not describe this product (and gives GOME as 1996-2011, while GOME_MINDS_NO2 covers 1995-2003).
The README does not name the OMI L1B collection or version used; the files carry an InputPointer attribute, but CMR granule metadata has no InputGranules.
Its parent, OMI_MINDS_NO2 version 1.1, is no longer in CMR (only version 2); the provenance of these granules cannot be followed in CMR.
The README describes this product at version 1.1 inside a document titled for versions 2.0 (OMI) and 1.1 (GOME and TROPOMI).

excluded.detail: Named generically; IMS has no CMR collection.
354 nm lies in both the UV-2 (307–383 nm) and VIS (349–504 nm) channels; the README does not say which is used.
The gridded products were made from L2 version 1.1, not 2.
Operational gridded analogues; no data dependency.

excluded.candidate: CALIOP and GOCART layer-height climatologies, TOMS/OMI surface-albedo climatology, AIRS CO climatology
